query: 查询所有Gold会员的客户ID和消费总额
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spend_usd FROM customers WHERE membership_tier = 'Gold'

query: 查询中国区的所有客户姓名和年龄
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, age FROM customers WHERE country = 'China'

query: 已流失的客户有多少个
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE churned = 1

query: 客户表中总共有多少条记录
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers

query: 消费总额最高的前5个客户是谁
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spend_usd FROM customers ORDER BY total_spend_usd DESC LIMIT 5

query: 查询年龄最大的10个客户ID和年龄
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, age FROM customers ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 10

query: 各个国家的客户数量
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY country

query: 每个会员等级各有多少客户
expected_sql: SELECT membership_tier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY membership_tier

query: 查询年龄在25到35岁之间的客户ID和年龄
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, age FROM customers WHERE age >= 25 AND age <= 35

query: 查询美国的女性客户ID
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA' AND gender = 'Female'

query: 所有客户的平均年龄是多少
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM customers

query: 查询退货次数最多的5个客户
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, returns_made FROM customers ORDER BY returns_made DESC LIMIT 5

query: 查询订阅了新闻邮件的客户数量
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE newsletter_subscribed = 1

query: 查询订单表中2025年的所有订单ID和日期
expected_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE year = 2025

query: 订单表中一共有多少条记录
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders

query: 各品类的商品数量统计
expected_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM product_summary GROUP BY category

query: 评分最高的10个商品名称和评分
expected_sql: SELECT product_name, avg_rating FROM product_summary ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10

query: 查询2024年1月的总营收
expected_sql: SELECT revenue_usd FROM monthly_revenue WHERE year = 2024 AND month = 1

query: 各会员等级的平均消费金额是多少
expected_sql: SELECT membership_tier, AVG(total_spend_usd) AS avg_spend FROM customers GROUP BY membership_tier

query: 每个国家的平均客单价对比
expected_sql: SELECT country, AVG(avg_order_value_usd) AS avg_aov FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY avg_aov DESC

query: 各获客渠道的客户数量分布
expected_sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY cnt DESC

query: 查询已流失且退货次数超过3次的客户列表
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, returns_made FROM customers WHERE churned = 1 AND returns_made > 3

query: 通过社交媒体渠道获客且年龄小于30岁的客户有多少
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE acquisition_channel = 'Social Media' AND age < 30

query: 统计2025年第一季度的订单总数
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE year = 2025 AND quarter = 1

query: 查询2025年每月的营收趋势
expected_sql: SELECT month, SUM(total_amount_usd) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

query: 订单评分不为空的订单中平均评分是多少
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(customer_rating) AS avg_rating FROM orders WHERE customer_rating IS NOT NULL

query: 各支付方式的订单数量统计
expected_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY cnt DESC

query: 每个订单状态下的订单数量和占比
expected_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

query: 折扣率超过20%的订单数占总订单数的比例
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN discount_pct > 0.20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM orders

query: 查询每月的新增客户数量趋势
expected_sql: SELECT year, month, new_customers FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY year, month

query: 2025年每个季度的总营收和订单量
expected_sql: SELECT quarter, SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(orders) AS total_orders FROM monthly_revenue WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

query: 每个品类中商品的平均评分和平均价格
expected_sql: SELECT category, AVG(avg_rating) AS avg_rating, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price FROM product_summary GROUP BY category

query: 退货率最高的5个品类及其退货率
expected_sql: SELECT category, AVG(return_rate) AS avg_return_rate FROM product_summary GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_return_rate DESC LIMIT 5

query: 使用Mobile设备下单且配送天数超过5天的订单有多少
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE device_used = 'Mobile' AND delivery_days > 5

query: 查询每个客户的订单总数和累计消费金额
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_usd) AS total_spend FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

query: 查询已流失客户的订单记录数量
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.churned = 1

query: 消费总额超过所有客户平均消费额2倍的客户有哪些
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spend_usd FROM customers WHERE total_spend_usd > (SELECT 2 * AVG(total_spend_usd) FROM customers)

query: 配送天数超过平均配送天数1.5倍的订单有多少
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE delivery_days > (SELECT 1.5 * AVG(delivery_days) FROM orders)

query: 每个会员等级在2025年的月均消费额
expected_sql: SELECT c.membership_tier, AVG(o.total_amount_usd) AS avg_monthly_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.membership_tier

query: 各品类的客户平均评分对比
expected_sql: SELECT o.category, AVG(o.customer_rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.category ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

query: 每个国家中消费总额排名前3的客户
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, country, total_spend_usd FROM (SELECT customer_id, country, total_spend_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_spend_usd DESC) AS rn FROM customers) t WHERE rn <= 3

query: 退货率高于品类平均退货率的商品名称
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.return_rate FROM product_summary p WHERE p.return_rate > (SELECT AVG(return_rate) FROM product_summary WHERE category = p.category)

query: 查询每个客户最近一次下单的日期
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

query: 复购客户与非复购客户的平均评分对比
expected_sql: SELECT is_repeat_customer, AVG(customer_rating) AS avg_rating FROM orders WHERE customer_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_repeat_customer

query: 2025年营收最高的月份以及该月的订单量和客单价
expected_sql: SELECT year, month, revenue_usd, orders, avg_order_value FROM monthly_revenue WHERE year = 2025 ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1

query: 每个国家的会员等级分布
expected_sql: SELECT country, membership_tier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY country, membership_tier ORDER BY country, membership_tier

query: 2025年每月的新增客户数和流失客户数对比
expected_sql: SELECT m.year, m.month, m.new_customers, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS churned_count FROM monthly_revenue m LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.churned = 1 GROUP BY m.year, m.month
unsolvable_reason: customers.churned is a static 0/1 label without churn_date; cannot attribute churn to a specific month

query: 过去90天内有退货记录的客户的会员等级分布
expected_sql: SELECT c.membership_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cnt FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.returned = 1 AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY c.membership_tier

query: 计算每个客户的客户生命周期价值（LTV），定义为累计消费额除以注册天数
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spend_usd / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), registration_date), 0) AS ltv_per_day FROM customers

query: 找出同时满足以下条件的客户：Gold会员、消费总额超过5000美元、且近30天内有购买记录
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE c.membership_tier = 'Gold' AND c.total_spend_usd > 5000 AND c.days_since_last_purchase <= 30
